sources.title: ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-2b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: To enhance safety, we recommend using granite-speech-5.0-2b alongside Granite Guardian. Granite Guardian is a fine-tuned instruct model designed to detect and flag risks in prompts and responses across key dimensions outlined in the IBM AI Risk Atlas.

sources.snippet: IBM has released Granite Speech 5.0 2B, a new open speech-language model for transcription and translation.
